audits.claim_text: For each confirmed Timeline and fixed binding plan, the current Explorer reports only closed horizon-free equivalence, replay-confirmed divergence, or an explicit non-decision/failure.
audits.scope: All 388 current dataset rows with category_v2 and ir_gt, evaluated once against the fixed outcome-visible Gemma-v3 candidate bytes under B1/B2/B5 binding, catalog-backed input modeling, H=None, 20-second and 768-MiB per-case limits.

run_selection.selection_rule: Include every one of the 388 protocol IDs exactly once; no post-outcome exclusions or retries.

excluded_runs.rationale: Historical bounded H=32 development result under predecessor semantics; retained but not pooled.
Different fixed candidate generation and pre-B5 evaluation snapshot; retained but not pooled.

check_results.rationale: Protocol preceded preparation and execution; all 388 IDs, B1/B2/B5 binding, H=None, caps, extractor non-use, and complete failure accounting are explicit.
Unconditional outcome rates and decision completion are separated; EQUIV requires closure with null bounded horizons and DIVERGE requires a replayed witness.
This block evaluates one verifier on fixed pairs and does not make a comparative baseline claim.
The JSONL contains 388 unique IDs in protocol order: 246 EQUIV-FIXPOINT, 57 DIVERGE_CONFIRMED, 23 REFUSED, 61 GENERATION_ERROR, and 1 PREPARATION_ERROR.
Descriptive fixed-corpus evidence only; there is one outcome-visible generation sample per familiar task and no population sampling uncertainty or independent H=None oracle.
Candidate bytes and evaluator inputs are fixed, but IR/JoI adapters, service model, observation, and advancement review are not independently implemented.
The candidate provenance manifest hashes all 388 reused bytes; the current protocol, manifest, outcomes, summary, and evaluator source snapshot are retained with digests.
The harness verified source and candidate hashes before and after execution; this establishes repository-local continuity, not external immutability.
This is self-review with no independent unbounded oracle, and the candidate tasks and outcomes were previously inspected.

independence.evidence: The same repository and evaluation authority define preparation, execution, and audit; predecessor outcomes are visible.

limitations: This run reuses outcome-visible Gemma-v3 candidates and is not a fresh-generation or confirmatory E3.
The 303/388 decision-completion rate is not code accuracy or natural-language intent accuracy.
EQUIV certifies equality to the supplied confirmed Timeline under the declared model, not satisfaction of the original utterance or physical deployment correctness.
There is no independent H=None semantic oracle; shared adapter and observation bugs remain possible.
Twenty-two refusals occurred during preparation and one additional SMT case refused during execution.
C15_005 and C18_003 remain known paired-reference quality concerns from predecessor documentation and are not excluded.

predecessor_failures.rationale: The present run uses H=None and checks closure for every positive; historical H=32 counts are not relabeled or pooled.
localhost:8002 refused connections and the repository SSH tunnel failed authentication, so fresh generation was not run.
All fixed bytes were retained, but evidence is explicitly exploratory.

audits.minimum_corrective_action: Restore the declared Gemma endpoint, freeze a new pre-generation protocol and candidate tag before any outcome inspection, run all 388 attempts with the same H=None accounting, and obtain independent semantic review before a confirmatory or accuracy claim.
